opponent.label: Velma
opponent.description: Velma Dinkley is the bespectacled resident genius of Mystery Inc. She's often the one who deciphers clues and solves the crimes. She has a fascination with mysteries and at times she can be very competitive with others who are as intelligent as she is. She frequently loses her glasses, which she desperately needs, being horribly nearsighted. She's a very serious skeptic, and has the philosophy that there is always a rational explanation behind everything.
